Dear [Mrs Suckling](../persons.html#1380)

Would you be so kind as to send the prospectus or at any rate some papers about the [Band of Mercy](../others.html#265) to [Mr Streatfield](../persons.html#2438) the clergyman of Kingsworthy (Winchester)  I am afraid I dont know his Christian name, but he seemed much inclined to join it with his schoolchildren, and I promised him to ask you to send him the papers

yours truly

C M Yonge
